problems.symptom: A producer writes to a field, store, id form, auth scope or peer that the consumer never reads, and status stays green: three disagreeing alphas, vestigial activity posteriors, the phantom activity_metrics table, fields with zero readers, escalations to an unread vessel, the gap store rewriting ids, a lesson JSONL writer storing the install preamble.
problems.root_cause: No contract that every write has a named reader. Writes are verified with the writer's own id, credential or store, never at the consumer.

problems.symptom: Judges, oracles and gates grade form, shape or presence instead of content. Closures are asserted without effect, 69% of closes are TTL expiry, self-retracted refutations count, headline reach of 48% is 92% self-scan ticks, and a local sha is graded as landed.
problems.root_cause: Verdicts are never reconciled against the receiver or the behavior, and instruments are never proven able to fail.

problems.symptom: Typecheck-clean autonomous commits on origin/dev that change nothing (inert fields, never-true predicates, shadowing consts, dropped sibling sites) or cannot parse. Each consumes the gap's one landing and seals it.
problems.root_cause: Gates read the diff; nothing parses, runs, or reads the consumer. Additive-only diffs are accepted.

problems.symptom: Substrate landings reverse contracts, delete guards (54b7762), reverse their own fixes via re-cutover (734393a), prepend hallucinated files into the live tree, truncate discovery-vessel, and push unparseable files.
problems.root_cause: Landings record WHAT not WHY; drafting happens against the live tree; there is no staged_base_sha==HEAD check; the deleted-guard class has no self-test.

problems.symptom: Landed code not in effect, or effect not in git: mirror excluding sql, no-op activity-api cutovers, library dist not rebuilt, masked-running units, wedged pull-sync (runtime state committed, stranded commits), unpushed commits destroyed, restarts on every push killing composes.
problems.root_cause: Three trees (/vessels runtime, /workspace/git clone, host repos) joined by several ad-hoc sync paths. The only true deploy test is process_start > file_mtime.

problems.symptom: Compose throughput collapses: 82.5% of picks refused at capacity after selection, compose storms, runaway awk, a vessel freezing on every gap write, concurrent composes discarding approvals, load timeouts charged to drafts, LLM credential starvation.
problems.root_cause: No envelope enforced at the resource. Environment failures are charged as fix failures. Operator credentials lapse, and wired providers (groq, mistral) were never keyed.

problems.symptom: The LLM plane was declared totally dead or quota-exhausted repeatedly while the hub was funded or free keys were simply unset.
problems.root_cause: Policy arms were disjoint from keyed models; llm-completion-dispatch had no failover; llmQuotaState reports key presence, not reachability; a provider 401 sets no cooldown.

problems.symptom: -narrowed or recommit children copy the parent verbatim with fa=0 and outrank it forever. Corrected re-dispatches reuse the same goal_hash. The gap store grew 7,323 -> 7,650 rows in one night. 391 recommit gaps were open.
problems.root_cause: Children reset attempt counts, and nothing checks whether the premise is still true. Operator retries seed the livelock.

problems.symptom: Gaps are born with truncated or nonexistent edit sites, false premises, already-fixed demand, or confabulated files for pathless goals. The drafter faithfully executes wrong instructions.
problems.root_cause: Gap text is prose sliced and echoed. Target files are checked for shape, not existence. No premise re-check runs before compose.

problems.symptom: Categories seal at 8+ attempts with 0 lands. The only escape posts to an unread vessel (248 unanswered). Load-timeout false negatives feed calibration. New gaps filed into sealed categories escalate immediately.
problems.root_cause: The seal learns from mislabeled failures, and its human exit is pinned to a replaced peer.

problems.symptom: Mechanisms built and validated once but never firing: census/validation families, the ReAct loop, the self-recovery timer, ESCALATE-to-log, a health detector watching 0 services, the exemplar selector, spectral gap / SF blend / TTSA, deterministic oracles.
problems.root_cause: Scheduling is env-gated or setInterval in short-lived processes. Detectors are never proven to complete, and their scope is never checked.

problems.symptom: Walk selections without posteriors; a never-reaching composition at 0.67 ev; PROVEN-BAD arms held selectable with beta withheld; a 1/1 cold-start inversion after honest grading; no learning curve on saturated probes.
problems.root_cause: Credit is keyed to clean exit rather than reach. Belief is split across six stores. Hierarchical priors are missing. Beta is withheld on failover and suppression holds.

problems.symptom: Derivation-over-source goals hollow-green on raw input shapes. Multi-source cardinality is lost. Internal vocabulary mis-infers target shapes. Shell CWD and env facts are missing. Honest goal reach is 5% (edit goals 2.4%).
problems.root_cause: Target inference picks tool or input shapes, and prompts lack environment facts. The grounded fallback only fires after reached===false.

problems.symptom: SurrealDB silently returns wrong answers: composite-index subsets return 0; equality is dropped beside datetime; GROUP ALL returns unfiltered counts; string/datetime compares mismatch; KNN plus filter scans (400x); poisoned views on empty tables; ~22 migrations fail cold boot.
problems.root_cause: Planner edge cases in 2.3.3 plus DEFINE IF NOT EXISTS divergence between warm and cold stores. There are no impossible-predicate controls in queries.

problems.symptom: Pinned loopback peers, libp2p rows rewritten to HTTP, hardcoded fallback endpoints, per-vessel /resolve envelope drift, discover() returning [] on 401, stale keys shadowing env, MCP concept tools returning 404.

principles: A commit is evidence a change was authored; only the current live file is evidence it is in effect. Re-verify after the next sync (09-14).
new_git_sha is not landing evidence; the honest predicate is pushed / is-ancestor origin/dev (09-14).
A landed sha is not the requested change: `reached` on an edit goal tests that a commit landed, not that the named function changed (08-10).
Never accept an additive-only diff as a fix: cite the reader by file:line, ask whether the predicate can ever be true, and measure the artifact (09-15).
A gate that READS a diff cannot certify reach; parse or run the artifact (09-19). A guard at the wrong stage protects nothing earlier (08-11).
A self-reverting loop is not self-correcting; read the whole sequence (08-03).
Adding a verifier to a class it cannot fully represent is worse than no verifier; abstain when completeness is unreachable (08-17).
Prove a check can fail before trusting that it passed; give every filtered aggregate an impossible-predicate control (08-17, 09-03).
A control must exercise the same writer and path as the value under test (09-06).
Read the receiver, never the worker's self-report (09-10).
Law-6 class detector: for each store with a designated writer, is it empty while its input is non-empty? (09-10).
A truncation safe for prose is a correctness bug for a path (09-10).
Answer a refuter with a measurement, never a restatement; a wrong-site refusal usually means missing evidence (09-10).
A metric change that cannot flatter you today is a repair; one that does is gaming. Test per rung (09-10).
A close must be gated on evidence the behavior stopped; a failed walk's writes must not survive its verdict (09-05, 09-06).
An unbounded existence predicate over an append-only ledger is immortal; time-bound falsifiers (09-11).
Nothing re-checks whether a gap is still true before composing; false-premise gaps masquerade as drafter defects (08-11, 09-11).
The drafter obeys; when the instruction is wrong the output is wrong. Goal content is the bottleneck: operator one-op edits 3/3 vs autonomous 4/26 (09-11).
Refusing to route is safer than routing to a guessed file (09-19). An exclusion that turns ambiguous into unique is dangerous (08-11).
The test suite is the substrate's only durable memory of its contracts; landings must record WHY, not only WHAT (08-29).
Before making a red test green, ask whether the behavior was removed on purpose (git log -S). Treat a substrate-authored reversal of a human contract as suspect (08-29).
Verify a write the way the consumer reads it (its id form, auth scope, list), never with the writer's own id or credential (08-29, 09-15).
A wrong gap left in the store is worse than an unfiled one: it is a standing instruction (08-29).
Fail-soft that keeps the shape but drops the fields is worse than failing (08-29).
A writer that pins a peer address cannot learn the peer was replaced; route by shape (09-22).
An escalation that only logs is not an escalation; after K byte-identical outcomes, stop restarting and file the error verbatim (09-11).
A restart re-runs ExecStart, never the install; check NRestarts, not ActiveState (08-19, 08-20).
A masked-but-running unit is a latent unrecoverable outage (08-15). A vessel healthy now can be dead on next boot (08-09).
A guard that fails loud still needs someone able to act on it (08-10). A gate that never opens is the same outage with a longer preamble (08-10).
Enforce caps at the resource; a cap in one plane does not bound another (08-09).
A control repeated under a constant confounder is not a control; environment failures must not be charged to the drafter (09-06).
Measure the effect per condition before naming a cause from the mechanism's inputs; bracket a step with a window that contains healthy data (09-13).
Honest grading on a 1/1 cold-start selector inverts the ranking; an auth failure must cool the arm (09-13).
A deterministic fast path is a shortcut past the walk's honesty gates (08-17). Grounding in a tool is not grounding in truth (07-23).
Correctness can live entirely in a deterministic gate so the generator can be weak (parity gate, 07-15).
Decompose below the ceiling, one hunk per goal, transcribe literal code, state a post-condition (07-15, 08-28, 09-11).
Probe the upstream resolver output before chasing downstream fixes (07-15, law 8).
